text:
Predicates:
NamedAfter(x, y) ::: x is named after y.
Settlement(x) ::: x is a settlement.
LocatedIn(x, y) ::: x is located in y.
Cove(x) ::: x is a cove.
Island(x) ::: x is an island.
PartOf(x, y) ::: x is part of y.
Bulgarian(x) ::: x is Bulgarian.
Antarctica(x) ::: x is Antarctica.

Premises:
NamedAfter(barutinCove, barutin) ∧ Settlement(barutin) ∧ Bulgarian(barutin) ::: Barutin Cove is named after the Bulgarian settlement of Barutin.
LocatedIn(barutinCove, southwestCoastSnowIsland) ∧ Cove(barutinCove) ::: Barutin Cove is on the southwest coast of Snow Island.
Island(snowIsland) ∧ Island(greenwichIsland) ∧ Island(deceptionIsland) ∧ PartOf(snowIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(greenwichIsland, southShetlandIslands) ∧ PartOf(deceptionIsland, southShetlandIslands) ::: The South Shetland Islands include Snow Island, Greenwich Island, and Deception Island.
PartOf(southShetlandIslands, antarctica) ::: The South Shetland Islands are considered part of Antarctica.
∀A ∀B ∀C ((LocatedIn(A, B) ∧ LocatedIn(B, C)) → LocatedIn(A, C)) ::: If A is located in B and B is located in C, then A is located in C.

Conclusion:
∃x ∃y (Cove(x) ∧ LocatedIn(x, antarctica) ∧ NamedAfter(x, y) ∧ Bulgarian(y)) ::: There is at least one cove in Antarctica named after a place in Bulgaria.
